perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Tracking Module
perks.desc: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Air Trigger

perks.name: Pulse Monitor

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Genesis
perks.desc: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Danger Zone

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Cluster Bomb

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.desc: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Bipod

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Reaper's Tithe
perks.desc: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Shield Disorient
perks.desc: Energy matched shield explosion disorients nearby combatants.

perks.name: Threat Detector

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.desc: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Increases blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Fleet Footed
perks.desc: Dealing damage grants you a short window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.desc: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 124 from 19 November 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3n08KP410ui1TXoEdBmsvu?si=2badf5a8fcac408d) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick use for sustained damage against boss enemies in general, and end-game underleveled content. Yesterday's Questions is a Trials of Osiris reward so not very accessible, and High Impact rocket launchers are only mid-tier for base damage so if you have a good boss damage RL already, you can safely pass. At base the stats are good - 45 Velocity equates to 34.85m/s, 67 Handling is 0.40s ready, 0.39s ADS and 0.33s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 35 is a 3.34s reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, you'll have total ammo of 10/11/12/12 (max 13). For a sustained DPS weapon there's going to be weapon swapping going on, so you'll need a handling barrel perk. Impact Casing as the magazine perk adds a little extra damage (×1.022). As a trait perk pairing, Envious Arsenal and Bait and Switch proc on the same condition of of doing damage with your other weapons to reload and boost damage by ×1.35. But if you don't get that, Air Trigger when enhanced maxes out your ammo reserves at 13 and (if you can bunny hop when the reload amination starts) reduce reload time to 2.31s. Unfortunately none of the origin traits really work for a boss damage roll, unless you're running solo content in which case use Alacrity. Recommended MW: Velocity or Handling with a Quick Access Sling mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 124 from 19 November 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3n08KP410ui1TXoEdBmsvu?si=2badf5a8fcac408d) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick use for burst damage against Major and Champion enemies in general, and end-game underleveled content. Yesterday's Questions is a Trials of Osiris reward so not very accessible, and High Impact rocket launchers are only mid-tier for base damage so if you have a good boss damage RL already, you can safely pass. At base the stats are good - 45 Velocity equates to 34.85m/s, 67 Handling is 0.40s ready, 0.39s ADS and 0.33s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 35 is a 3.34s reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, you'll have total ammo of 10/11/12/12 (max 13) or with Bipod 15/16/17/17 (max 18). For a burst DPS weapon you'll be more interested in Velocity or handling from the barrel perk. Impact Casing as the magazine perk adds a little extra damage (×1.022). In the first trait perk column, Envious Assassin can overflow your magazine in the background, ready for burst damage or Air Trigger when enhanced maxes out your ammo reserves at 13 (18 for Bipod) and (if you can bunny hop when the reload amination starts) reduce reload time to 2.31s. In the second column, Explosive Light boosts damage by ×1.25 for six rockets (7 when enhanced) or Bipod just allows you to shoot multiple rockets without reloading. Of the origin traits, Alacrity is great for solo activities, and you will probably get some use out of One Quiet Moment. Wild Card's bolts will only drop after you kill a miniboss, so they won't help kill it but could help with crowd control after. Recommended MW: Velocity or Handling with a Quick Access Sling mod or, when enhanced and the artefact mod's around, a Stunloader mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 124 from 19 November 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3n08KP410ui1TXoEdBmsvu?si=2badf5a8fcac408d) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice utility PvE pick use for boss damage in a fireteam in general, and end-game underleveled content. Yesterday's Questions is a Trials of Osiris reward so not very accessible, and High Impact rocket launchers are only mid-tier for base damage so if you have a good boss damage RL already, you can safely pass. At base the stats are good - 45 Velocity equates to 34.85m/s, 67 Handling is 0.40s ready, 0.39s ADS and 0.33s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 35 is a 3.34s reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, you'll have total ammo of 10/11/12/12 (max 13) or with Bipod 15/16/17/17 (max 18). For a burst DPS weapon you'll be more interested in Velocity or handling from the barrel perk. Impact Casing as the magazine perk adds a little extra damage (×1.022). If you're role is to buff fireteam damage, Withering Gaze in the first trait perk column will weaken targets to effectively buff everyone's damage by ×1.15 for 6s - enough time to reload and re-proc again. Frenzy maxes reload speed and handling and adds a useful, if not damage topping ×1.15 weapon damage on top. Unfortunately none of the origin traits really work for a boss damage roll, unless you're running solo content in which case use Alacrity. Recommended MW: Velocity with a Quick Access Sling mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 124 from 19 November 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3n08KP410ui1TXoEdBmsvu?si=2badf5a8fcac408d) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick use for add clearing in general, and end-game underleveled content. Yesterday's Questions is a Trials of Osiris reward so not very accessible, and High Impact rocket launchers are really best placed for an add clearing role with the big blast radius which... seems like a waste for a RL. At base the stats are good - 45 Velocity equates to 34.85m/s, 67 Handling is 0.40s ready, 0.39s ADS and 0.33s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 35 is a 3.34s reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, you'll have total ammo of 10/11/12/12 (max 13). If you really insist on add clearing, maximise the blast radius and then boost velocity with the barrel and mag perks. Envious Assassin will overflow your magazine as you rack up kills with other weapons, or Air Trigger when enhanced maxes out your ammo reserves at 13 and boosts reload if you can remember to start the animation while you're in the air. Chain Reaction's combatant damage multiplier is the best on a rocket launcher, so that should take out beefier adds and majors easily. The Wild Card origin trait works well for this roll, laying traps for any remaining adds nearby. Recommended MW: Blast Radius or Velocity with a Quick Access Sling mod.
